extracted.name: Sweet Dijon Salad Dressing
extracted.description: A sweet onion Dijon vinaigrette that is perfect for your next green salad. This tangy dressing is easy to whip up and use over and over again.
ingredient_lines: 4 (1 gram) packets granular sucrolose sweetener (such as Splenda®)
instruction_lines: Place vinegar, Dijon mustard, oil, and sugar substitute into a jar with a tight-fitting lid. Close the jar, and shake vigorously to blend. Refrigerate until chilled before using.
